description: Retrieve AI developments from the last N days (default 7), filterable by category (e.g., model_release, paper, mcp), source (e.g., arxiv, github), and importance (low/normal/high/breaking). The category is a keyword label derived from the headline at ingest, not a curated classification — filtering by it narrows the feed but does not guarantee every row belongs; the response repeats this caveat whenever a category filter is applied.

category.description: Filter by category (e.g., model_release, paper, funding). Heuristic headline label, not a curated taxonomy — check the titles.

importance.description: Filter by importance: low, normal, high, breaking

source.description: Filter by source (e.g., arxiv, hackernews, github)

name: get_recent
